ranger:1.title: Ranger
ranger:1.notes: Waits ahead of the run. Holds a wide standoff off the crown and lobs a glowing purple orb after a one-second aim.

ranger:2.title: Ranger
ranger:2.notes: Longer standoff and a slightly quicker orb. Many bells can share a pack.

ranger:3.title: Ranger
ranger:3.notes: Harder tiles pack more bells. Orbs stay large and close faster.

ranger:4.title: Ranger
ranger:4.notes: Hard-patch bells still throw a purple orb from farther out.

rhino:1.title: Rhino
rhino:1.notes: Meteor strike only. Lines up on a slow target. Matches a runner with lag then cuts ahead into the intercept. Backs off if the player is too close.

rhino:2.title: Rhino
rhino:2.notes: Same meteor. Closes the lead a little sooner and hits harder.

rhino:3.title: Rhino
rhino:3.notes: Starts the meteor from farther out and keeps the lagged frame.

rhino:4.title: Rhino
rhino:4.notes: Hard patches field a crowd of chargers. Meteor comes out faster.

rammer:1.title: Rammer
rammer:1.notes: Waits ahead of travel and winds up from a stop into a dive once the player closes.

rammer:2.title: Rammer
rammer:2.notes: Appears a bit farther out on a fast run and reaches a higher ram speed.

rammer:3.title: Rammer
rammer:3.notes: Faster wind-up. Many eyeballs can share a pack.

rammer:4.title: Rammer
rammer:4.notes: Hard-patch rams hit harder and finish the dive sooner.

rift_hulk:1.title: Rift-Hulk
rift_hulk:1.notes: Box brute. Not called by field patches.

rift_hulk:2.title: Rift-Hulk
rift_hulk:2.notes: Tougher slam. Still a box spawn only.

rift_hulk:3.title: Rift-Hulk
rift_hulk:3.notes: Late-box hulk. Field patches still do not call it.

gloam:1.title: Gloam
gloam:1.notes: Two-winged swarm. Jogs in to bite over and over. Cannot sprint. When the player runs they fly ahead, land in the way, and bite again.

gloam:2.title: Gloam
gloam:2.notes: Tougher swarm biters. Still jog on the ground and only fly to cut in front of a runner.

gloam:3.title: Gloam
gloam:3.notes: Harder inlet tiles pack a thicker Gloam swarm. Bite stays close-range.

gloam:4.title: Gloam
gloam:4.notes: Late inlet swarms hit harder. Still a jog on foot, a cut-in when you run.

vesper:1.title: Vesper
vesper:1.notes: Four-winged patrol. First packs start on Quiet Inlet 4 and Quiet Inlet 4 Southeast. Later patrols hug Stormwatch and Meridian Tower. Locks a red telegraph beam before it fires.

vesper:2.title: Vesper
vesper:2.notes: Quicker lock on the inlet start and later castle grounds. Same telegraph

vesper:3.title: Vesper
vesper:3.notes: Harder inlet and castle tiles keep more Vespers in the air.

vesper:4.title: Vesper
vesper:4.notes: Late inlet and castle beams charge faster and hit harder.

threnody:1.title: Threnody
threnody:1.notes: Six-winged cursed giant. First packs start on Quiet Inlet 4 and Quiet Inlet 4 Southeast. Later giants hug the castle and office grounds. One per pack. Drops shock columns.

threnody:2.title: Threnody
threnody:2.notes: Tougher cursed giant. Still starts on the first-city inlet tiles.

threnody:3.title: Threnody
threnody:3.notes: Late inlet and castle tiles still field only one Threnody.

threnody:4.title: Threnody
threnody:4.notes: Hard-patch Threnody on the inlet start and later castle grounds. Columns drop a bit sooner.

gruk:1.title: Gruk
gruk:1.notes: Castle bruiser. Charges and swings. Preset pad. Does not respawn.

gruk:2.title: Gruk
gruk:2.notes: Tougher castle bruiser. Still a one-shot garrison pad.

gruk:3.title: Gruk
gruk:3.notes: Harder Gruk. Castle pads do not refill.

gruk:4.title: Gruk
gruk:4.notes: Late-tile Gruk. Same charge and swing.

nix:1.title: Nix
nix:1.notes: Smaller castle runner. Charges and swings. Does not respawn.

nix:2.title: Nix
nix:2.notes: Quicker Nix. Still a one-shot pad.

nix:3.title: Nix
nix:3.notes: Harder Nix. Castle pads stay empty after a kill.

vex:1.title: Vex
vex:1.notes: Holds the back line and lobs a red mortar from his staff. Does not respawn.

vex:2.title: Vex
vex:2.notes: Same staff mortar. Hits a bit harder.

vex:3.title: Vex
vex:3.notes: Harder Vex. Pads stay empty after a kill.

vex:4.title: Vex
vex:4.notes: Late-tile Vex. Red mortars from the staff tip.

kestrel:1.title: Kestrel
kestrel:1.notes: Spawns ahead and rides the run like a ranger, then gatling-fires minigun bolts.

kestrel:2.title: Kestrel
kestrel:2.notes: Quicker burst. Matches a faster runner the way a ranger does.

kestrel:3.title: Kestrel
kestrel:3.notes: Harder office tiles pack more flying gunners.

kestrel:4.title: Kestrel
kestrel:4.notes: Late-run office gunner. Stays on a runner and dumps the minigun.

bastion:1.title: Bastion
bastion:1.notes: Deagroed office grid. Does not chase. Lobs one high trailed shell when the player passes, then can despawn. Dies on a red fuse and bursts.

bastion:2.title: Bastion
bastion:2.notes: A denser deagroed grid and a slightly harder lob.

bastion:3.title: Bastion
bastion:3.notes: Harder office tiles plant a thicker bastion grid.

bastion:4.title: Bastion
bastion:4.notes: Late-run office grid. Still slow, still one high lob.

weaver:1.title: Weaver
weaver:1.notes: Office spider. Hops after a runner, then burns Laser Eyes for a second.

weaver:2.title: Weaver
weaver:2.notes: Faster hop catch-up and a hotter Laser Eyes burst.

weaver:3.title: Weaver
weaver:3.notes: Harder office tiles pack more hopping weavers.

weaver:4.title: Weaver
weaver:4.notes: Late-run office hunter. The swarm is mostly spiders.

scout:1.title: Scout
scout:1.notes: Flying saucer. Banks as it tracks, holds a green sight, then freezes that aim and fires pink pulse beams. Drops a Gray on death.

gray:1.title: Gray
gray:1.notes: Runs in to take aim and lobs a slow green homing orb. Some walk the field; more drop from killed scouts.

tanglemaw:1.title: Tanglemaw
tanglemaw:1.notes: Swarm biter. Comes from any side, including behind, and cannot keep up with a runner. Bites apply Slow.

scout:2.title: Scout
scout:2.notes: Quicker lock. Same pink pulses and a Gray drop.

gray:2.title: Gray
gray:2.notes: A slightly quicker aim and a harder slow orb.

tanglemaw:2.title: Tanglemaw
tanglemaw:2.notes: Tougher swarm. Still a slow chase from every side.

scout:3.title: Scout
scout:3.notes: Harder tiles keep more scouts in the air.

gray:3.title: Gray
gray:3.notes: Harder tiles keep more riflemen on the ground.

tanglemaw:3.title: Tanglemaw
tanglemaw:3.notes: Harder tiles pack a thicker Tanglemaw swarm.

scout:4.title: Scout
scout:4.notes: Late-run saucer. Pulses come out a bit sooner.

gray:4.title: Gray
gray:4.notes: Late-run gray. The orb still crawls and homes.

tanglemaw:4.title: Tanglemaw
tanglemaw:4.notes: Late swarm. Bites still stack Slow to five seconds.
